ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount, then go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
ideas.quote: We identify this common risk factor in the data by building monthly portfolios of currencies sorted by their forward discounts.

rules.market: Currency forwards; the paper also examines a developed-country currency sample that includes major currencies.
rules.entry: Sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount; go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest.
rules.exit: Rebalance portfolios at the end of every month.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency baskets.
